main_visual_task: The coffee wakes her - the finished cup lands steaming at the bedside, her eyes open calmly in the light, she sits up and cradles the cup, then turns to the window and smiles as steam curls through the sunbeam, ending on a held hero frame where the cup and her quiet joy share the light.

user_script_review.note: 同 segA；B段注入首尾帧关键帧(参考图工作流)

prompt_bible.subject_lock: the same young Chinese woman around twenty-eight with dark shoulder-length hair and natural East Asian features wearing a cream cotton sleep top; the man appears only as the hands that set the cup down; the same unlabeled white ceramic cup, glass bean jar and brewer; no branding anywhere
prompt_bible.environment_lock: the same quiet modern Chinese home bedroom, soft white bedding, light wooden bedside table, sheer curtains, rain-fresh window with soft blue morning city outside, no other people
prompt_bible.material_lock: real human skin with visible pores and micro-texture, real cotton bedding weave, real crema and milk foam, ceramic glaze, physically plausible steam ribbons
prompt_bible.lighting_lock: the same hard warm sunrise beam from the upper-left window now fully in the room, with a fixed cool blue fill
prompt_bible.palette_lock: morning gold, cream white bedding, warm wood, espresso brown, soft window blue
prompt_bible.lens_texture: live-action 35mm commercial cinematography on a real cinema camera, true-to-life photographic rendering, natural skin subsurface scattering, practical light falloff, filmic soft contrast, shallow depth of field
prompt_bible.screen_direction: the light beam travels left-to-right; the cup ends centered with her smile above it; label areas remain blank
prompt_bible.audio_policy: calm diegetic rhythm only: the cup landing softly, her gentle waking breath, a distant waking city, one final steam hiss; no voice and no dialogue

internal_shots.visual_state: the finished white cup with its foam heart is set gently on the bedside table, landing inside the sunbeam
internal_shots.subject_action: the man's hands place the cup and slide quietly out of frame as thin steam rises
internal_shots.camera_action: locked close-up on the cup in the beam
internal_shots.focus: foam heart and the rising steam
internal_shots.lighting_state: the beam gilds the cup rim against the cool bedroom
internal_shots.end_state: the cup stands alone steaming in the light

camera_plan.motivation: the gift arrives with the light
camera_plan.start_position: close-up level with the bedside table
camera_plan.path: camera remains locked as the hands place and leave
camera_plan.focus_transition: hands and cup to the rising steam
camera_plan.axis_lock: cup centered in the beam, hands exit right
camera_plan.stop_condition: cut when the hands fully leave the frame

internal_shots.visual_state: her sleeping face in the soft light, lashes trembling as the steam and aroma reach her
internal_shots.subject_action: her eyes open calmly, a breath passes, and the beginning of a smile touches her mouth
internal_shots.focus: her lashes and eyes as they open
internal_shots.lighting_state: warm beam light softens across her face
internal_shots.end_state: she is awake, calm, gently present

camera_plan.motivation: stillness makes the waking feel real
camera_plan.start_position: close-up on her face at pillow level
camera_plan.path: camera does not move at all
camera_plan.axis_lock: her face stays centered, light from the left
camera_plan.stop_condition: cut as the first smile begins

internal_shots.visual_state: she sits up in the white bedding and cradles the steaming cup in both hands, bringing it close
internal_shots.subject_action: she wraps her hands around the warm cup and lifts it toward her face as steam drifts past
internal_shots.camera_action: one slow push-in as she settles with the cup
internal_shots.focus: her hands around the cup, then the cup and her face together
internal_shots.lighting_state: full morning sun warms her side while cool light holds the room
internal_shots.end_state: she holds the cup near her chest, peaceful

camera_plan.motivation: the warmth passes from cup to hands to heart
camera_plan.path: push slowly in toward the cup in her hands
camera_plan.speed_curve: slow constant push with gentle ease
camera_plan.focus_transition: cup on the table to her hands to her face above the rim
camera_plan.end_position: medium close-up on the cup and her face
camera_plan.axis_lock: push along the bed axis only, cup stays centered
camera_plan.stop_condition: cut once the cup rests near her chest

internal_shots.visual_state: she turns to the window and her smile blooms as she raises the cup toward the light, steam curling through the sunbeam
internal_shots.subject_action: she gazes out at the morning city and smiles while the steam ribbons rise past her face
internal_shots.camera_action: locked hero framing holding perfectly still through the final hold
internal_shots.focus: her smile above the cup with the steam and window glow
internal_shots.lighting_state: balanced sunrise key and cool fill with a gentle bloom
internal_shots.end_state: a held hero frame - the cup centered low in the light, her soft smile above it, steam still rising

camera_plan.motivation: the product and her quiet joy share one final light
camera_plan.start_position: medium close-up with her and the cup in the beam
camera_plan.path: camera locked in place while only the steam moves
camera_plan.focus_transition: her smile to the steaming cup below
camera_plan.axis_lock: cup centered and vertical, nothing drifts
camera_plan.stop_condition: hold the still frame for the final one and a half seconds

first_frame: the white cup with a foam heart standing steaming in the sunbeam on the bedside table
last_frame: held hero frame of the woman smiling toward the window with the steaming cup centered in the sunbeam below her face
